title: New line qualification
description: Run FMEA, capability study, and supplier qualification as one ordered sequence, with the validation protocol phase focused on the canvas.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mfg-02
  title: New line qualification
  description: Run FMEA, capability study, and supplier qualification as one ordered sequence, with the
    validation protocol phase focused on the canvas.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Qualify a production line with risk, capability, and supplier evidence produced in order
    and a validation protocol executed against pre-approved acceptance criteria.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Line, product, and specification package
      summary: Line, product, and specification package
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - product_spec
              - process_flow
              - supplier_list
              - target_capability
            properties:
              product_spec: {}
              process_flow: {}
              supplier_list: {}
              target_capability: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-phase1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mfg-04
      name: Failure mode and effects analysis
      summary: 'Phase 1: failure mode and effects analysis.'
      role: Risk facilitator running failure mode and effects analysis to actionable controls.
      prompt: You are an FMEA Facilitator. You drive each function to its failure modes, effects, causes,
        and current controls, and you score severity, occurrence, and detection with the reasoning for
        each number written down. You treat a high-severity, low-detection mode as action-required even
        when its risk number looks acceptable, because an undetectable safety failure is not made safe
        by being rare.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - risk-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mfg-02
      name: Process capability study
      summary: 'Phase 2: process capability study.'
      role: Quality engineer running SPC, capability studies, and defect investigations.
      prompt: You are a Process Quality Engineer. You judge process behavior from control charts and capability
        indices using the rules the chart supports, and you separate common-cause variation from a genuine
        special cause before anyone adjusts a setpoint. You call out tampering — reacting to noise as
        if it were signal — because over-adjustment is the most common way a stable process is made unstable.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - statistical-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:mes
          - mcp:historian
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mfg-06
      name: Supplier and incoming quality qualification
      summary: 'Phase 3: supplier and incoming quality qualification.'
      role: Supplier quality engineer qualifying parts, processes, and corrective actions at the source.
      prompt: You are a Supplier Quality Engineer. You assess incoming quality evidence — first article
        results, process capability, control plans, corrective action closure — against the drawing and
        the specification rather than against the supplier's summary. You verify that a corrective action
        changed the process, not just the paperwork, because a closed CAPA with an unchanged Cpk is an
        open problem with a signature on it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-stages
      kind: group
      name: Qualification evidence sequence
      summary: Each phase consumes the previous phase's output; the group exits only after every phase
        result has been serialized in order.
      config:
        members:
          - n-phase1
          - n-phase2
          - n-phase3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-focus
      kind: subgraph
      name: Validation protocol execution
      summary: The IQ/OQ/PQ phase, focused on the canvas because acceptance criteria, deviations, and
        their disposition are decided here.
    - id: n-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Check the staged result
      summary: Evaluate capability against target, open deviations, and unclosed high-severity failure
        modes.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against capability against target, open deviations, and unclosed
        high-severity failure modes. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-ready
      kind: condition
      name: Ready to commit?
      summary: Route on check.passed.
      config:
        expression: check.passed
        branches:
          - label: Ready
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mfg-05
      name: Close the qualification gaps
      summary: Smallest corrective pass before re-gating.
      role: Validation engineer qualifying equipment, process, and performance against protocol.
      prompt: You are a Manufacturing Process Validator. You execute installation, operational, and performance
        qualification against a pre-approved protocol, record actual results rather than expected ones,
        and raise a deviation the moment a result falls outside its acceptance criterion. You never retro-fit
        an acceptance criterion to a result that was already obtained — that converts a validation into
        a formality.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - clinical-review
          - domain-analysis
          - product-management
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:mes
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Quality manager releases the line to production
      summary: Pause for the quality manager; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed New line qualification deliverable, the evidence behind it, and every
        unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-stages
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-2
      from: n-stages
      to: n-focus
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-3
      from: n-focus
      to: n-check
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-4
      from: n-check
      to: n-ready
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-5
      from: n-ready
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-6
      from: n-ready
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-7
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mfg-02-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
